description: The Republic of Ireland's Health Service Executive (HSE) has approved gemcitabine, cyclophosphamide, vincristine, and prednisolone (GCVP, 21 days) for reimbursement as a treatment option for the treatment of patients with high-grade non-Hodgkin lymphoma who are unsuitable for R-CHOP due to impaired cardiac function or other co-morbidities. The treatment regimen notes that rituximab is to be included for CD20 positive patients.
